newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yaskawa Elec up on bright business hopes.
newsitem.headline: Yaskawa Elec up on bright business hopes.

text.p: Yaskawa Electric Corp's shares jumped on Wednesday afternoon, as investors bought the shares due to the firm's bright business prospects, brokers said.

The electric motor manufacturer's shares were up 28 yen at 472 as of 0444 GMT. Turnover totalled 3.55 million shares, making the company the fourth most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo bourse.

Brokers said that the firm's industrial robot division, which is expected to be very profitable, and Yaskawa's semiconductor related business, which contributes greatly to the firm's earnings, were seen having bright prospects.
Yaskawa said late last week that it expects group net profit to hit 4.00 billion yen in the 1997/98 year ending March, up from 1.21 billion in the previous year.
